title: OAgents shared conformance-evidence object
description: The canon data contract for an OAgents conformance/audit evidence record. Reconciles the workflow-orchestration pattern v0.1.2 shared evidence object (ADR-EA-0027) with the thinx-aidex FOrCE audit record (cross-ai #62) and the OAgents §6 evidence model. Both an orchestration run and a conformance check emit this object, so an OAgents conformance harness and a thinx-gated action produce the same record shape. OTel-GenAI is the transport substrate (the base fields map to gen_ai.* span attributes); the governance fields (lineage FK, gate_decision, authority_context, control_id) are the canon EXTENSION OTel lacks. Pattern-level data contract; promotion into the OAgents NIST spec is gated by Micah co-authorship (ADR-EA-0008).

evidence_id.description: Unique id for this evidence record.

orchestration_run_id.description: The run this record belongs to (the orchestrator's run id). Null for a top-level/standalone action.

parent_evidence_id.description: Lineage FK to the parent evidence record — REQUIRED for any spawned child (workflow-orchestration criterion 5). Null only at the lineage root. Without it, aggregation is correlated logs, not recoverable evidence.

command_digest.description: Hash/digest of the command or args (not the raw secret-bearing command).

control_id.description: OAgents control this record is evidence for (e.g. 'qg-01'), per controls.yaml. Null for non-conformance operational evidence.

conformance_level.description: OAgents conformance tier the control belongs to (1=Basic, 2=Standard, 3=Autonomous).

policy_id.description: Which gate/policy/tier fired (an id, not free-text) — e.g. the FOrCE gate tier or the OAgents gate id.

authority_context.description: The envelope/principal under which the action was evaluated (OrdSA authority altitude + principal chain). The 'which authority' an action carried — absent in flat-RBAC systems.

gate_decision.description: The gate outcome (the workflow-orchestration / FOrCE gate decision). For a conformance check, `outcome` carries the control verdict.

outcome.description: authorized/refused/escalated/timeout-deny for an action gate; pass/fail/not-applicable for a conformance control check.

envelope_delta.description: The refinement applied at spawn — how the child envelope narrows the parent (envelope(child) ⊑ envelope(parent)). Per-limb: permissions/gates/verification/discipline.

at.description: When the decision was made — at spawn, mid-run, or at conformance review.

decision.description: Flat decision mirror of gate_decision.outcome, for consumers that read a single field.

determinism_flag.description: Was the gate/check enforced deterministically (in the control layer), or inside a probabilistic call? (workflow-orchestration Contribution 2 — a gate the runtime can route around is unreliable.)

substrate.description: Provider/runtime the action executed on (e.g. 'openai', 'claude-cli', 'ng-runtime'). Criterion-7 reach: tells a reviewer whether the gate was actually on the path.

annotation.description: Operator-authored human-judgment layer, FK'd to evidence_id (the thinx-aidex annotation model).
